f-041-029-02.label: ربنا أرنا
f-041-029-02.note: Abū ʿUmar from al-Yazīdī is al-Dūrī of Abū ʿAmr. An-Nashr (vol. 2 p. 222) gives the ikhtilās of this word from Abū ʿAmr by al-Dūrī.

f-041-044-02.label: أعجمي
f-041-044-02.note: The question form of أأعجمي (Hishām's single hamza is the first position at this verse). The author adds that Ḥafṣ and Ibn Dhakwān follow by analogy, with both hamzas and no separator, and that some teachers give Ibn Dhakwān the lengthening; he calls that unsound. Those remarks name no fixed reading and are not entered.

f-041-047-01.label: من ثمرات
f-041-047-01.note: The Taḥbīr sentence names Nāfiʿ, Abū Jaʿfar and Ibn ʿĀmir for the plural and gives the singular to the rest, so Ḥafṣ is shown with the rest. an-Nashr (vol. 2 p. 367) and al-Mabsūṭ both name Ḥafṣ with the plural. The entry follows the Taḥbīr sentence as printed.

f-041-050-01.label: إلى ربي إن لي
f-041-050-01.note: The edition prints أبو عمر without the final wāw; an-Nashr (vol. 2 p. 367) gives the fatḥ of this yāʾ to Abū Jaʿfar, Abū ʿAmr and Warsh, with a dispute about Qālūn.
